notes.title: Malfunction II - QOL Update
notes.notes:
Where have I been?
Apologies for the long silence! Rest assured I've been hard at work on the next addition to the game. There are MANY changes coming but I'll address that once the update is here.

However I would like to share some screenshots!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/ce5e65fa4f4300c35d9b125c19f95f81d72e5e45.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/b5e408a734a10e3fc2f60d086e30f821fcf3ef76.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/ba5dc6e53a1a4e9533f752f90ce9b86fe74d2579.png

One thing important to note is that the entirety of Chapter 1 is getting a MASSIVE overhaul in terms of detail, depth and exploration. There will be plenty of new puzzles & scenarios to uncover on-top of the already established levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/a4cc5a00d9c743db4980d137cde7b94fa7113592.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40929880/376bef3c92a08353e29e131a26b4bdbf7db8b011.png

While I don't have an ETA, I can assure you that I'm hard at work on this game and am making sure it fit's the quality that I personally am striving towards.

Thanks for reading and I hope to post here again sometime soon! Have a good one!
